searches.note: Twenty four searches of a share of twenty eight, four unspent. Two searches served the whole group (WienWein and the DAC rules; the ÖTW's Vienna sites) and are counted with Wieninger. One search for Zahel's Kaasgraben aspect and Demeter year returned nothing on the house and is counted with Zahel; one for the decline of the field blend is counted with Wieninger. No fetch tried. A Falstaff portrait whose title names the living buyer of Mayer am Pfarrplatz was read but is listed nowhere.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: the founding year, the people and their dates, the classification, the grapes, the sites, the making, the window, the service, the label, every beat of the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules.

The searches went first to the dates the stories turn on (WienWein's founders and later members, the DAC, the count's 1773, the city's 1907, the Mayer sale, Christ's 1927 and 1959, Zahel's 1930, 1966 and 1989), then to the house sheets for sites and making.

Where a house's two pages disagreed (Christ's barrel months and vine age) the record says less; where an account was not found (the 1989 label, the destemming, the decline of the 1980s, the marine terrace) it was cut.

tested: WienWein of 2006 and its four founders (Wieninger, Christ, Edlmoser, Zahel): wein.plus and the Vienna Tourist Board's press text; stands.
The DAC of the 2013 vintage and its rules (three varieties, none above half, the third at least a tenth): Austrian Wine's region page; stands.
Ried Ulm as an Erste Lage of the ÖTW on the Nussberg, labelled since the 2017 vintage: Meininger and the Vienna press text list Ulm among Vienna's twelve; stands.

Biodynamic since 2008, certified with the 2011 harvest; nine varieties; three quarters steel, a quarter large old oak, ten months on fine lees, then assembled: the house's sheets for 2018 and 2023; stand.
The soil: the house's sheets give extremely calcareous shell limestone, a former Tertiary coral reef; the author's marine terrace over Vienna sandstone was not found and is replaced.
The story's decline of the late 1980s: no source dated it; replaced.

Rules: no living person named (the houses Christ, Edlmoser and Zahel appear as house names only); no price, score or volatile figure; British; no dash. The questions: one key each; the year distractors are the record's own dates and teach.

codexInTension.tension: The library lists Wiener Gemischter Satz Ried Nussberg, a label not found; the wine is Ried Ulm Nussberg. Its Grand Select as a barrel aged white blend may mean the house's Chardonnay Grand Select, as the author reports.
Calls Wiener Gemischter Satz DAC the only appellation in the world built on co-planting rules, a superlative claim this checker did not test.
None found: the DAC of the 2013 vintage and its three varieties agree with Austrian Wine.
